question: First four terms of a series are 4, 12, 36, 108. What will be the 6th term of this series?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the constant multiplier ratio in the series pattern directly.

Each term is multiplied by 3 (4 × 3 = 12, 12 × 3 = 36).

We already have the 4th term which is 108.

5th term = 108 × 3 = 324

6th term = 324 × 3 = 972

**∴ The correct answer is 972.**
